newsitem.title: FRANCE: French truck strike may hit sugarbeet deliveries.
newsitem.headline: French truck strike may hit sugarbeet deliveries.

text.p: A nationwide truckers' strike now in its 11th day could hold up delivery of sugarbeet to French refineries if it continues, sugar producers and beet planters said on Thursday.
The harvest is over but 15 percent of the crop must still be delivered to refineries, planters said.
Eridania Beghin-Say said its sugar producing unit Beghin-Say feared possible disruption in beet and sugar deliveries if the strike were to last.
"We may face serious transport problems if the strike goes on two or three more days," a spokesman told Reuters.
Because of fuel shortages, the transport of beets to refineries and of refined sugar to clients could be disrupted, he said.

Planters said that because trucks used to collect sugar beets were using small country roads, they were less likely to be held up in blockades set up on France's main highways. But the growing fuel shortage is a source of concern, they said. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
